verdict.rationale: Codegen's agent-permissions docs describe a setting that lets the agent automatically detect and apply rules from rule files in your repositories, which covers adding a conventions context file the agent picks up. The evidence is a single brief settings description, though, with no detail on how this improves plans or code. Missing for 10: supported file names and formats, how the rules shape plan and code generation, any precedence or scoping behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
